sql: SELECT j.label, i.label, m.label, z.flag FROM human AS h LEFT JOIN jobless AS j ON h.label = j.label LEFT JOIN impaired AS i ON h.label = i.label LEFT JOIN masculine AS m ON h.label = m.label LEFT JOIN zero_balance AS z ON h.label = z.label WHERE h.label IN ('student180', 'student117')
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(m.label) FROM impaired AS i LEFT JOIN masculine AS m ON i.label = m.label
SELECT b.label FROM insolvency_record AS b INNER JOIN zero_balance AS z ON b.label = z.label WHERE z.flag = 'neg'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobless AS j INNER JOIN impaired AS i ON j.label = i.label INNER JOIN maximum_truancy_span AS t ON t.label = j.label WHERE t.period = 8
